company.name: Serinus Biosciences
company.shortDescription: Serinus Biosciences develops technologies to understand how chemicals work inside malignant tumor cells.
company.description:
Serinus Biosciences develops technologies to understand how chemicals work inside malignant tumor cells. They are developing a new generation of AI for drug development by leveraging knowledge-primed models and cancer biology. Their technique makes it possible to create medicines that are effective for a variety of patient groups, bypass resistance mechanisms, and support combinations by design.

Serinus Biosciences is headquartered in New York City, New York and was founded in 2022.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Serinus Biosciences combines Combinations Prioritization for Resistance to Clinical Compounds with ResCuE.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
